code: library(dplyr)  safs <- file.path(tempdir(), "made-up-safs") dir.create(safs, showWarnings = FALSE) set.seed(2026) n <- 80 tx_date <- as.Date("2014-01-01") + sample(0:1825, n, replace = TRUE) end_date <- as.Date("2022-12-31") older <- sample(c(FALSE, TRUE), n, replace = TRUE) living <- runif(n) < 0.3  # Death, graft failure and loss to follow-up at made-up rates. death <- tx_date + round(365.25 * rexp(n, 0.04 * ifelse(older, 2.2, 1) * ifelse(living, 0.6, 1))) graft <- tx_date + round(365.25 * rexp(n, 0.05)) lost <- tx_date + round(365.25 * rexp(n, 0.04)) last_fu <- pmin(death, lost, end_date) reported <- death <= last_fu ssa_only <- death > last_fu & death <= end_date  made_up_tx <- tibble(   TRR_ID = 900000 + seq_len(n),   PERS_ID = 800000 + c(seq_len(n - 2), 1, 2),   REC_TX_DT = tx_date,   REC_AGE_AT_TX = ifelse(older, sample(60:75, n, TRUE), sample(20:59, n, TRUE)),   DON_TY = ifelse(living, "L", "C"),   REC_TX_ORG_TY = c(rep("KI", n - 3), "KI LI", "KI", "KI"),   CAN_PREV_TX = c(rep(0, n - 2), 1, 1),   REC_POSTX_LOS = sample(3:10, n, replace = TRUE),   REC_DISCHRG_DT = tx_date + 7,   REC_ACUTE_REJ_EPISODE = sample(c(1, 3), n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.1, 0.9)),   PERS_OPTN_DEATH_DT = if_else(reported, death, as.Date(NA_character_)),   PERS_SSA_DEATH_DT = if_else(ssa_only, death, as.Date(NA_character_)),   TFL_DEATH_DT = if_else(reported, death, as.Date(NA_character_)),   TFL_GRAFT_DT = if_else(graft <= last_fu, graft, as.Date(NA_character_)),   TFL_LAFUDATE = last_fu,   TFL_ENDTXFU = end_date,   PERS_RETX = as.Date(NA) )  # One follow-up form a year until last follow-up. made_up_forms <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {   years <- seq_len(floor(as.numeric(last_fu[i] - tx_date[i]) / 365.25))   if (length(years) == 0) {     return(NULL)   }   tibble(     TRR_ID = made_up_tx$TRR_ID[i],     TRR_FOL_ID = made_up_tx$TRR_ID[i] * 100 + years,     ORG_TY = "KI",     TFL_PX_STAT_DT = tx_date[i] + round(365.25 * years),     TFL_FOL_CD = 10 * years,     TFL_MALIG = sample(c("N", "Y"), length(years), TRUE, c(0.95, 0.05)),     TFL_ACUTE_REJ_EPISODE = sample(c(3, 1), length(years), TRUE, c(0.93, 0.07))   ) }))  haven::write_sas(made_up_tx, file.path(safs, "TX_KI.sas7bdat")) haven::write_sas(made_up_forms, file.path(safs, "TXF_KI.sas7bdat"))  # Point sRtr at the made-up folder for this page only; restored at the end. old_wd <- Sys.getenv("SRTR_WD", unset = NA) Sys.setenv(SRTR_WD = safs)
